message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the appropriate charge(s) based on the facts.

Facts: In Tianjin Baodi district, on Nov 7 2016, defendant Yang set fire to ex-wife's property: corn husks, corn cobs in a steel shed, then went to main house, set clothes in wardrobe on fire, causing fire in house, damage valued 17905 yuan. He voluntarily surrendered and confessed.

This is arson (intentional fire). In examples, similar facts: using lighter to set fire to house, causing damage, labeled "放火". Also "失火" used for accidental fire (unintentional). Here it's intentional to vent emotions, so "放火". So answer: [罪名]放火<eoa>

Check if any other charge like "故意毁坏财物"? That is for property damage without fire. Here fire is arson, so "放火". So single charge.
